name: Wonderful Days
source:
Wonderful Days tells the story of Elliott, a shy dragon who just moved to another country to live with his new roommate Jamie, an easy-going koala.

[From [url=https://rionmaro.itch.io/wonderful-days-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Wonderful Days》讲述了腼腆的龙艾略特的故事。他刚搬到另一个国家，与随和的考拉杰米成为室友。

[摘自[url=https://rionmaro.itch.io/wonderful-days-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
